name: Kuonji Shinra
source:
Eldest of the Kuonji sisters; she has a habit of teasing the people she likes and a fondness for cute things. In public she works as a famous conductor in orchestra.

[Based on [url=https://en.m.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kimi_ga_Aruji_de_Shitsuji_ga_Ore_de&diffonly=true]Wikipedia[/url]]
